provenance.scope: Exact original Instant task/workspace/node IDs; snapshot and active-workspace counts scoped to owned resources

sourceQueries.node: SELECT id,status FROM nodes WHERE id='01M4B4YSAHYFGDZ247S6F9MG6D'
sourceQueries.snapshots: SELECT COUNT(*) AS snapshot_count FROM session_snapshots WHERE chat_session_id='36200219-1ea0-43ff-8a8d-f119c68c56ca' AND project_id='01KJNR9R3TEN3KX1ETE33852R8'
sourceQueries.active: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_count FROM workspaces WHERE node_id='01M4B4YSAHYFGDZ247S6F9MG6D' AND status NOT IN ('deleted','stopped','error')
sourceQueries.task: SELECT id,status,completed_at,output_pr_url FROM tasks WHERE id='01M4B4YQ4F2HF0YX5Q62MGFVPN'
